In any triangle, the following relationship holds when a median is drawn from a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side:

PQ² + PR² = 2(PT² + QT²)

This formula is derived from the median theorem, which states that the sum of the squares of the two sides of a triangle (PQ and PR) is equal to twice the sum of the square of the median (PT) and the square of half the base (QT), i.e., the length of the segment from P to the midpoint of QR.

The correct answer is: PQ² + PR² = 2(PT² + QT²)

questions.questionHtml:
If tanθ = 
5_________8
 , then find the value of 
(1+cosθ)(1-cosθ)_________(1+sinθ)(1-sinθ)

 यदि tanθ = 
5_________8
 , तो मान ज्ञात करें  
(1+cosθ)(1-cosθ)_________(1+sinθ)(1-sinθ)
questions.solution:
From tan(θ) = 5/8, we have:

sin(θ) = 5k and cos(θ) = 8k, where k is a constant.(We use this representation to maintain the ratio of sin(θ) to cos(θ)).

Using the identity sin²(θ) + cos²(θ) = 1, we can find k:

25k² + 64k² = 1

89k² = 1

k² = 1/89

k = 1/√89

Now, substitute k = 1/√89 into the values of sin(θ) and cos(θ):

sin(θ) = 5/√89 and cos(θ) = 8/√89.

Next, substitute these values into the given expression:

Expression = [(1 + cos θ)(1 - cos θ)]/[(1 + sin θ)(1 - sin θ)]

Substitute cos(θ) = 8/√89 and sin(θ) = 5/√89:

[(1 + 8/√89)(1 - 8/√89)]/[(1 + 5/√89)(1 - 5/√89)]

Using the formula (a + b)(a - b) = a² - b²:

=> (1² - (8/√89)²) / (1² - (5/√89)²) = (1 - 64/89) / (1 - 25/89)

=> (89/89 - 64/89) / (89/89 - 25/89) = (25/89) / (64/89)

=> 25/64

questions.solution:
Let the number of candidates appeared from state Z in the year 2008 is x
